AssayDetails: SKin buffer washes (2 per participant) to be used for proteomics, microbiomics and  microbial qPCR
objectives: Currently there is a lack of representation and fundamental host biological and microbiological understanding spanning the various omics areas on polycultural consumers in the Unilever Beauty and Personal Care programme. Externally, there is clear under-representation of people of non-European ancestry such as Africans (3%) and Hispanics (0.5%). These consumers are under-served and under-represented and unsurprisingly, there is a lack of products developed and designed based on their needs and requirements.     This study is designed to bridge that gap, to gain insights on consumer understanding of Polycultural consumer hair and scalp. It will focus on polycultural subjects in the USA, specifically Black/African American and Hispanic consumers as well as White/Caucasian consumers to identify unique and common insights across polycultural consumers. The study is aimed to reveal new biome and consumer insights, novel targets, and new insights through integration of the biology with consumer understanding.     Primary Objective: To investigate the biology of dry and non-dry skin in a multi-cultural population in the USA. Secondary Objective: To investigate whether there are differences in the biology of dry and non-dry skin between African American, Hispanic and Caucasian women in the USA.
